children: was upgraded to Overweight from Neutral at Piper Sandler, citing that continued multiple compression has improved risk-reward.
Shares were 1.13% higher at $150.73 during pre-market trading on Friday.

"Our prior Neutral rating reflected JKHY's valuation premium, not concerns about the durability of its earnings stream. Core-client retention above 99%, a record 58 competitive core wins in FY26, increasing success with larger institutions, and rising trifecta penetration support our confidence in the company's FY27-FY29 growth framework," said analyst Bill Carcache.

"Our upgrade does not require material near-term monetization of AI, data analytics, SMB, stablecoin, or other newer platform initiatives; these provide potential upside rather than underpin our forecast," said the research note.
